featured_reviews.name: Ramandeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Gurudwara is located right along the Vasai West highway, making it very easy to access. There is plenty of parking available, though it can get quite crowded during festival seasons. The Langar Hall is on the ground floor, and Gurbani Kirtan takes place on the first floor, creating a peaceful and spiritual atmosphere.

The restrooms were neat and clean, and langar is available most of the time, which is greatly appreciated by visitors. Overall, the place is well-maintained and offers the same warmth and serenity you’d expect from any Gurudwara.

A calm and welcoming space for everyone.

customer_updates.name: Fayaz Shaikh
customer_updates.text: A holy shrine is a sacred place or structure dedicated to worship, prayer, or religious rituals. It often holds significant religious or spiritual importance to believers, serving as a focal point for pilgrimage and devotion. Shrines can vary in size and architectural style, ranging from small, simple structures to grand, ornate buildings. They may house relics, statues, or other objects of veneration, and are typically adorned with symbols, artwork, and decorations reflecting the faith and traditions associated with them. Visitors to holy shrines often seek solace, guidance, healing, or blessings through their interactions with the divine.

featured_reviews.name: Fayaz Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visitors to holy shrines often describe a profound sense of peace and spiritual connection during their time there. The atmosphere is often charged with a palpable sense of reverence and devotion, as pilgrims from all walks of life come together to pay homage to their faith. Many report feeling a deep sense of awe and humility in the presence of the sacred relics or icons housed within the shrine.

The act of prayer or meditation within the shrine's sacred space can be a deeply personal and transformative experience. It's not uncommon for visitors to feel a sense of clarity, renewal, or inner healing as they pour out their hopes, fears, and aspirations before the divine. Some believers even attribute miraculous healings or interventions to their time spent in prayer at a holy shrine.

Additionally, the communal aspect of pilgrimage adds to the blessings experienced. Sharing in the collective devotion of fellow pilgrims can foster a sense of unity and solidarity, reinforcing the bonds of faith and community. Many pilgrims leave holy shrines with a renewed sense of purpose and spiritual strength, carrying the blessings of their journey with them as they return to their daily lives.

विरारमधील जीवदानी देवी मंदिर हे केवळ धार्मिक स्थळ नाही, तर मानसिक शांतता मिळवून देणारा एक अनुभव आहे. सुमारे १३‍०० पायऱ्या चढून वर पोहोचल्यावर जे समाधान मिळते, ते शब्दांत मांडणं कठीण आहे. थकवा असतो, घाम असतो, पण मन मात्र हलकं झालेलं असतं. कदाचित म्हणूनच लोक वारंवार इथे येतात.
मंदिर परिसर स्वच्छ आणि नीटनेटका आहे. सकाळच्या वेळी हवेत गारवा असतो आणि आजूबाजूला पसरलेला हिरवळ मनाला प्रसन्न करते. वरून दिसणारा विरारचा परिसर आणि समुद्राचा अंदाज देणारा वारा हे दृश्य खास आहे. देवीचं दर्शन साधं पण प्रभावी आहे. कुठलाही दिखावा नाही, फक्त श्रद्धा.
ज्यांना पायऱ्या चढणं शक्य नाही त्यांच्यासाठी रोपवेची सोय आहे, जी व्यवस्थित आणि सुरक्षित आहे. त्यामुळे वयस्कर लोक आणि लहान मुलांसोबत येणाऱ्यांसाठीही हे ठिकाण सुलभ झालं आहे. स्वयंसेवक आणि मंदिर कर्मचारी सहकार्य करणारे आहेत, जे आजकाल दुर्मिळच वाटतं.
सणांच्या दिवशी आणि नवरात्रात गर्दी प्रचंड असते, तेव्हा थोडा संयम ठेवावा लागतो. पण त्या गर्दीतही एक वेगळी ऊर्जा जाणवते. इथे आल्यावर वेळ थांबल्यासारखा वाटतो आणि रोजच्या गोंधळापासून थोडा ब्रेक मिळतो.
एकूणच, जीवदानी देवी मंदिर हे श्रद्धा असो वा नसो, प्रत्येकाने एकदा तरी अनुभवावं असं ठिकाण आहे. इथे येऊन मनाला खरंच “मजा होते”.
#Virar 👁️

featured_reviews.name: Sushil kumar kushwaha
featured_reviews.review_text:
On Jivdani hill in Virar,  Maharashtra, one of the most revered temples of Jivdani Mata, an incarnation of the goddess Adi Shakti is nestled, serving as a major divine landmark near Mumbai.
To reach the hilltop shrine one has to climb approx. 1375 well built stone stairs (takes around 40 minutes in easy way) or you may opt for a funicular service available at base.( Charges ₹250 per adult, To & Fro).
It is an ancient temple with caves and cisterns on the hill, offering stunning views of the city and surrounding area.
All amenities like food with lodging, public restrooms and a variety of shops are available near the entrance.
The Temple generally operates from 4:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily.
The shrine attracts rush on weekends/ holiday, weekdays are better.
Must visit for a powerful spiritual aura and inner peace !!!

featured_reviews.name: Kautuk Tare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Jivdani Temple and it was truly a fulfilling experience 🙏
A peaceful and spiritual place located on top of a hill, with a steady climb of around 220 meters elevation gain that makes the journey both challenging and rewarding. Each step feels like devotion, and the panoramic views from the top are absolutely worth the effort.
The calm atmosphere, fresh air, and divine energy at the temple give a sense of peace and satisfaction. Perfect for a short spiritual trek with a mix of fitness and faith.
Definitely a must-visit! 🌄✨

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Dhopat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jivdani Devi Temple is a very peaceful and powerful spiritual place. The temple is located on a hill, and the view from the top is absolutely beautiful. The atmosphere feels calm, positive, and full of devotion. 🙏✨

The darshan experience is very good, and the fresh air and nature around the temple make the journey even more special. Climbing the steps can be tiring, but the peaceful feeling after reaching the temple is worth it.

A must-visit place for blessings, peace, and amazing views. 🌄🔱

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Soman
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Jivdani Mata Temple on a Sunday morning 🌅, and it turned out to be a truly peaceful and spiritually uplifting experience. Despite it being a weekend, the atmosphere was surprisingly calm 😌. There was a considerable crowd, but the darshan was smooth and quick 🙏, which made the visit even more pleasant.
I chose to climb via the steps instead of using the ropeway 🚶‍♂️🛕, and honestly, it was 100% worth it 💯. The entire walk itself feels like a spiritual journey. Along the way, you can see monkeys playing around 🐒, greenery all around 🌿, and devotees deeply immersed in faith—some even climbing on their knees as an act of devotion 🙇‍♂️, which is truly humbling to witness.
As you climb higher, the positive and divine vibes grow stronger ✨🕉️. Once at the top, the temple premises feel serene and powerful, and the darshan fills you with peace and gratitude 🧘‍♂️❤️. The view from the top 🌄 is an added blessing and makes every step worthwhile.
Overall, Jivdani Mata Temple is not just a place of worship but a complete spiritual experience 🌸🙏. Highly recommended to visit early in the morning and, if possible, take the steps at least once in your lifetime 🚶‍♀️✨.
Jai Jivdani Mata 🙌🌺

featured_reviews.name: Ramgopal Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
My visit to Jivdani Temple was a very peaceful and spiritual experience.
The temple is located on a hill, and the view from the top is beautiful.
The atmosphere is calm and filled with positive energy.
Overall, it was a memorable visit and I would love to go there again. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Keswani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing mandir with aesthetic spiritual vibrations and really good view and breeze. This mandir has 3 god idols there Jeevdhani Mata, Kaal Bhairav Bhagwaan and Mata Lakshmi.

Going by steps is an amazing experience; if you are going for the first time then you must go by steps if are able to climb steps from your health perspective.

You can take small rest after every 200 steps and still reach to mandir and take darshan within 1 hour if medium crowd(that was my experience). Yes while coming back down we took more and bigger relaxing breaks so it took around 1 hour 15 min to get back down.

featured_reviews.name: Shalini Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very good experience at Jivdani Mata Temple Ropeway. The ropeway journey was smooth, safe, and very well managed. I was lucky enough to attend the afternoon aarti at 12 PM, which was truly divine and peaceful.
The surroundings of the temple are calm and spiritually uplifting, and I felt a deep sense of peace after darshan. The ropeway ticket costs ₹250 per person for a two-way journey, which is totally worth it considering the comfort and time saved.
Overall, it was a beautiful and satisfying spiritual experience. I would definitely recommend visiting Jivdani Mata Temple via ropeway to anyone seeking peace and a smooth darshan experience.

featured_reviews.name: praniket more
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Mahakali Temple in Virar is truly a captivating spiritual destination. During my recent visit, I was mesmerized by the striking black stone Mahakali idol, which stands majestically as the focal point of the temple. Its imposing size and intricate craftsmanship imbue the entire space with a sense of divine energy and reverence. The idol’s presence is powerful, instantly drawing attention and inspiring awe in every visitor, whether a devotee or a curious traveler.
What truly sets this temple apart is its vibrant interior, where the walls are adorned with enlarged depictions of all Mahakali’s awtaras. Each avatar is rendered with remarkable detail and creativity, spanning the length of the temple walls in a mesmerizing visual display. These artistic representations not only tell the timeless story of Mahakali’s many forms but also contribute to a meditative and uplifting atmosphere. The interplay of traditional motifs and vivid colors create an immersive experience that leaves a lasting impression.
The overall ambiance is serene and welcoming, making it an ideal spot for reflection or prayer. Whether you seek spiritual solace, artistic inspiration, or a glimpse into Maharashtra’s rich cultural heritage, the Mahakali Temple at Virar is sure to be an unforgettable and enriching experience.

featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
😊I visited Mahakali Mandir during Navratri, and it was an amazing and divine experience! 🙏✨ The idol of Maa Mahakali is very big — so tall and powerful that you instantly feel blessed after seeing her. This is a Sthanik Mandir, so you can visit anytime in the year, not only during Navratri.

But I will suggest going during Navratri, because the temple looks absolutely beautiful at that time. The decorations, lights, and the festive atmosphere make the place even more special. The Devi’s decoration during Navratri looks like a grand home — full of energy and positivity. 💫

If you ever get a chance, do visit once — especially during Navratri. You will definitely feel peace and positive vibes here. 🌸🙏

featured_reviews.name: SAHIL TIVAREKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mahakali Temple is truly one of the most peaceful and spiritually uplifting places I have visited. Nestled amidst a serene environment, the temple offers a beautiful blend of devotion, architecture, and positive energy. The moment you step inside, you can feel a strong sense of calm and divine presence. The idol of Goddess Mahakali is incredibly powerful and beautifully adorned, making the darshan a deeply fulfilling experience.

The temple premises are kept very clean and well-maintained. The staff and volunteers are courteous, helpful, and always ready to guide visitors, especially during peak hours or special occasions. The daily aarti is a major highlight—its rhythmic chants and devotional atmosphere create a mesmerizing experience that touches the heart.

Accessibility is also convenient, with clear signboards and parking facilities available nearby. On weekends and festival days, the crowd increases, so visiting early in the morning or late in the evening is ideal for a peaceful darshan. The surrounding area has small shops where you can buy flowers, prasad, and devotional items at reasonable prices.

What I appreciate most is the sense of community and devotion among the visitors. Whether you come here for prayer, meditation, or simply some quiet time, the temple offers an environment that refreshes both mind and spirit.

Overall, Mahakali Temple is a must-visit for anyone seeking spiritual comfort, cultural richness, or a moment of peace from daily life. Highly recommended for families, devotees, and tourists alike.
